Features [![People paddling in a canoe on a blue lake and a mountain ahead of them](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/info/Features-640-x360/Homepage-feature-Kath-Lake.jpg?modified=20221123025316)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit/services/kathleen) ### [Explore Kathleen Lake](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit/services/kathleen) Paddle out on stunning Kathleen Lake, set up camp in the peaceful forested campground, hike King’s Throne trail, or enjoy a picnic at the Day-Use Area. [![Close up of hiking boots](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/info/Features-640-x360/Activities-Feature-Hiking.jpg?modified=20221123033841)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/randonnee-hiking) ### [Take a hike!](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/randonnee-hiking) Kluane has everything from short easy hikes to epic backcountry treks. Find trail descriptions and backcountry permit and safety information. ## Most requested - [Visitor centres](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit/services/info) - [Flightseeing](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/aeriennes-flightseeing) - [Mountaineering](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/alpinisme-mountaineering) - [Rafting the Alsek River](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/alsek) - [Commercial film and photography](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/gestion-management/tournage-film) - [Roadside attractions](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit/services/route-road) ## Visiting Kluane National Park and Reserve ### [Activities and experiences](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ) Things to do, hiking, camping, visitor centres, interpretive programs, flightseeing, rafting, and roadside attractions. ### [Plan your visit](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit) How to get here, maps and directions, facilities and services, fees, visitor guidelines. ### [Safety and guidelines](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/securite-safety) Bear safety, backcountry safety, winter safety, Important Bulletins, and more. ### [Camping and overnight accommodations](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/camping) Kathleen Lake Campground, oTENTik, backcountry camping. ## About Kluane National Park and Reserve ### [Nature and science](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/nature) Conservation and science, animals, plants, the environment, and research. ### [Culture and history](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/culture) Indigenous culture, park history, cooperative management. ### [Stewardship and management](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/gestion-management) Park Management Board, public consultations, plans, commercial permits, research permits. Kluane is located in southwest Yukon, 160 km west of Whitehorse. 


Plan your visit

| | [How to get here](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit) ### Contact us PO Box 5495 Haines Junction YT Y0B 1L0 Email address:[kluaneinfo@pc.gc.ca](mailto:kluaneinfo@pc.gc.ca) Phone numberVisitor Information: 867-634-5134 Phone numberAdministration: 867-634-7250 **24 hour emergency dispatch** Phone number:1-780-852-3100 ### Hours of operation [Haines Junction Visitor Centre](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit/services/info#Daku) **May 15 to September 20** Every day: 9 am to 5 pm [Thechàl Dhâl Visitor Centre](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit/services/info#thech%C3%A0l) **May 20 to September 6** Every day: 10 am to 4 pm [Kathleen Lake Campground](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit/services/kathleen#2 "Kathleen Lake Campground") [Overnight registration](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit/inscription-registration) ### Social - [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/ParksCanadaYukon/) - [Twitter](https://x.com/ParksCanYukon) ## More places to discover with Parks Canada [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/yt/yt-chilkoot-lhn-nhs-640x360.jpg?modified=20221125212558)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/yt/chilkoot) ### [Chilkoot Trail National Historic Site](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/yt/chilkoot) Hike a legendary trail through the northern Coast Mountains, from Alaska’s Taiya Inlet to the headwaters of the Yukon River in northern British Columbia. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/yt/yt-ss-klondike-lhn-nhs-640x360.jpg?modified=20221125212558)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/yt/ssklondike) ### [S.S. Klondike National Historic Site](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/yt/ssklondike) Steam-powered sternwheelers were the Yukon’s link to the outside world for almost a century. The S.S. Klondike National Historic Site in Whitehorse honours these vessels, so vital to the settlement of the North. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/yt/yt-klondike-lhn-nhs-640x360.jpg?modified=20221125212558)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/yt/klondike) ### [Klondike National Historic Sites](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/yt/klondike) Step back into the days of the 1898 Klondike Gold Rush. Prowl a paddlewheeler. Explore goldfields. Magical Dawson City is a frontier town where history mingles with everyday life. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/yt/yt-vuntut-pn-np-640x360.jpg?modified=20221125212558)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/vuntut) ### [Vuntut National Park](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/vuntut) Explore untouched northern landscapes and learn the story of the Vuntut Gwitchin people and their relationship to the land and animals of the northern Yukon. # Safety and guidelines

## Kluane National Park and Reserve

We rarely head out for an outdoor adventure with the expectation that something will go wrong, and most times everything will go right. However, sometimes the unexpected happens and when it does, it's important that you are well informed and well prepared to minimize the negative impacts of unfortunate circumstances.

For important information about staying safe while enjoying Kluane National Park and Reserve, please explore the topics below.

### Important Bulletins

- [Find a list of warnings, closures and alerts for Kluane National Park and Reserve.](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/securite-safety/bulletins)

[![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/securite-safety/Saftey-feature---Bears_Elliott.jpg?modified=20170213180910)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/securite-safety/ours-bears)

### [Bear safety](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/securite-safety/ours-bears)

Kluane is home to both grizzly and black bears. Familiarize yourself with the principles and practices of safe travel in bear country.

[![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/securite-safety/Safety-backcountry-Mueller.jpg?modified=20170213180807)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/securite-safety/plan)

### [Backcountry safety](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/securite-safety/plan)

You must be self-sufficient and able to handle emergency situations on your own. Plan ahead and ensure that you are properly equipped.

[![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/securite-safety/winter-safety-Muellerf.jpg?modified=20170213180924)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/securite-safety/hiver-winter)

### [Winter safety](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/securite-safety/hiver-winter)

Kluane is a winter wonderland with fun for all! To ensure you have a safe and enjoyable trip, please be prepared!

[![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/securite-safety/safety-mountaineering-Parks-Canada.jpg?modified=20170213180901)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/alpinisme-mountaineering/secur-safe)

### [Mountaineering](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/alpinisme-mountaineering/secur-safe)

Mountaineering parties must be entirely self-sufficient and able to handle emergency situations on their own.

[![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/securite-safety/safety-biking-Mueller.jpg?modified=20170213180841)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/velo-biking#activ5-2)

### [Mountain biking safety](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/velo-biking\#activ5-2)

Have the ride of your life! Get geared up, be safe on the trails, respect the environment and other trail users.

[![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/securite-safety/Safety-rafting-Noel-Hendrickson.jpg?modified=20170213180816)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/alsek/hazards)

### [Alsek River safety](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/alsek/hazards)

The Alsek is a remote wilderness river, with cold water, powerful rapids and ice floes. Plan ahead and be prepared!

Safety is everyone's responsibility. At Parks Canada, we do our part to make sure you can have a safe visit by assessing the risks, managing hazards, and making sure that safety information is freely available. You can do your part as visitors by making sure you seek out the information you need to stay safe and make well informed decisions while enjoying these special places. Visit our website and stop at a visitor center to speak with our employees for the most up to date information. Make sure you are fully prepared for whatever activities you choose to participate in so you can have a safe, enjoyable and memorable visit.

# Camping

## Kluane National Park and Reserve

Camp at scenic Kathleen Lake Campground, stay in a cozy oTENTik tent, or head out into the backcountry for an unforgettable overnight hiking trip.

### Frontcountry camping

Kathleen Lake is Kluane National Park and Reserve's destination for highway accessible vehicle-based camping.

[![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/activ/Camping/camping-kathleen-350_pc-fmueller.jpg)\\
Kathleen Lake Campground](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit/services/kathleen#camping)

[![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/activ/Camping/otentik-350_pc-pgowdie.jpg)\\
oTENTik](https://www.pc.gc.ca/en/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit/services/kathleen/hebergement-accommodation-pcrs)

[![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/activ/Camping/propre-bare-350_pc-pgowdie.jpg)\\
"BARE" campsite program](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit/services/kathleen/camping-propre-bare-camp)

### Backcountry camping

Overnight backcountry permits/registration and de-registration is mandatory for all overnight use in Kluane National Park and Reserve between April 1 and Novmeber 15. The use of approved bear-resistant food canisters is mandatory.

[![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/activ/Camping/arriereppays-backcountry-350_pc-fmueller.jpg)\\
